description: Set text frame options: convert between point and area type (Type > Convert To Area Type / Point Type), resize the type area without scaling the text, Area Type Options (rows, columns, gutters, inset spacing, first baseline, text flow), Optical Margin Alignment and anti-aliasing

antiAliasing.description: Anti-aliasing of the type in raster output

convertTo.description: Convert point type to area type or back first

firstBaselineMin.description: First baseline minimum offset in points

height.description: Area type: height of the type area in points

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

textFlow.description: Text flow across rows first or down columns first

width.description: Area type: width of the type area in points

name: set_text_frame_options
title: Set Text Frame Options
